name: Neritic-Vortex
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed an ancient meteor crater in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.

Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the escape pod debris field are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
